text: Affordability Florida cannot become too expensive for working families and seniors on fixed incomes. The status quo has a cost. Progress doesn't pay the bill sitting on your kitchen counter today—it's time to bring down costs. Learn more →

Economy California passes heavy regulations. New York sends you the bill. Florida puts out the welcome mat. Bureaucratic delays shouldn't stop honest people from opening a business and earning a living. Learn more →
Education Reading by third grade is a basic promise every child deserves. Every student should Read to Succeed, stay active and healthy, and have a debt-free route to a great-paying job. Learn more →

Healthcare You deserve to know what healthcare costs before you get treated. Your Doctor, Your Price puts you back in charge, cuts out the red tape, and lets doctors focus on their patients. Learn more →
Law and Order We must secure our borders, keep local neighborhoods safe, stop taxpayer handouts to illegal immigration, and keep deadly drugs off our streets. Learn more →

Space and Tech Every American who walked on the Moon took off from Florida's coast. It's time to bring NASA home, build out our launchpads, and create thousands of high-paying jobs right here in Florida. Learn more →
